sections.advice: Food stop near Cognin → High point near Saint-Martin-du-Frêne is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

Treat High point near Saint-Martin-du-Frêne → Scenic stretch in Buellas as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

sections.to: Near Saint-Yan, on the way back
sections.advice: Scenic stretch in Buellas → Near Saint-Yan, on the way back is the reward section in Lyon. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.advice: Photo stop near Noirétable → Near Miribel is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.
